result: The company dashboard is a projection of the existing 268/269 read models: revenue, net costs, profit, cash, fleet value and company level; a shared 12-month chart/table window where a missing month is null/fără date and a real zero or negative profit stays visible; cost breakdown by category and last ride; purchase/upgrade cards with cost, effect, state, in-panel confirmation and explicit insufficient-cash, level and duplicate refusals. A native Company button in the shell host opens the dialog with focus, Tab trap, Escape, pause-surface semantics, 10 Hz updates while open and zero reads/renders while closed. No second ledger, fleet, XP/profile write or history scan is created.
limitations: Cost, level and effect values remain calibration proposals. Fleet value is the acquisition sum without depreciation or resale. The browser fixture page exercises the real 268/269/270 modules, while the live-shell browser probe verifies mounting, surface and focus but does not buy an upgrade inside the live world. The KPI popup (267), file persistence/reload (278), physics (282) and learning remain out of scope. No FPS/GPU claim; local Node is 24.19.0 below the declared engine range.
